Designed for both seasoned divers and watch enthusiasts, the Caloura combines cutting-edge technology with timeless elegance, ensuring it stands out on any wrist. Unmatched Durability and Precision Case and Bezel: Material: Crafted from premium 316L brushed stainless steel, the Caloura's case is built to withstand the harshest underwater conditions. Features: The unidirectional rotating stainless steel bezel, adorned with a ceramic insert, ensures precision timing and added scratch resistance. Lume: Equipped with BGW9 lume, both the bezel and dial offer superior visibility in low-light conditions. Crown and Case Back: Crown: The screw-down crown guarantees a secure, water-tight seal, essential for maintaining the watch's integrity at great depths. Case Back: The reverse engraved 316L stainless steel case back, featuring a screw-in construction, adds an extra layer of protection and elegance. Crystal Clear Viewing Glass Type: The flat sapphire crystal offers unparalleled scratch resistance. Coating: Enhanced with a triple-layer anti-reflective coating on the inner side, the crystal ensures a clear view of the dial from any angle, reducing glare and improving readability. Elegant and Functional Dial Colors: Choose from four stunning embossed sunray dials, each capturing light in a unique way to enhance visibility and style. Indexes: Applied hour indexes, luminescent with BGW9, provide exceptional clarity and a touch of sophistication. Comfortable and Secure Bracelet Material: The 316L stainless steel bracelet promises durability and comfort. Adjustment: Featuring a fast adjustment extension buckle, the bracelet can be easily adjusted to fit over a wetsuit or for everyday wear. Reliable Movement Type: Powered by the Seiko NH35/NH38 automatic movement, known for its robustness and precision, ensuring that your timepiece keeps accurate time, dive after dive. Built for the Deep Water Resistance: With a water resistance of 30ATM (300 meters), the Borealis Caloura is perfectly suited for professional diving adventures and underwater explorations.
